question: Which Plate defaults and public plugin contracts serve a product job, and which duplicate an adequate Plite owner?
method: best-api-review/history-v2; bounded single-proposal review; Redesign from First Principles; Best API ideal-call and hard-cut methods; Plate/Plite ownership comparison
trigger: After the collaboration implementation, the user challenged whether extend or configure should support required resource inputs and generic capability inference so dedicated Yjs forwarding factories are unnecessary. Assessment and review recording only.
requirements: Reusable Plate and copied presentation definitions must bind required host resources without nullable defaults or per-layer generic forwarding factories.

The declaration owns the input-to-capability relationship; awareness, compaction and cursor-validator inputs must specialize exact editor, portal and hook types without arbitrary consumer API replacement.
Preserve one native Yjs binding, app-owned provider/doc/awareness lifetimes, exclusive seed grants, namespace claims, activation/rollback/disposal and exact mounted-view identity.
Preserve shared nominal descriptor ancestry and ordinary typed extension; required inputs must be satisfied before installation without a parallel public configuration store or runtime.
Judge changes to current configure, extend and the native-to-Plate adapter against the dedicated factory, and distinguish a worthwhile design direction from unproved implementation.
evidenceReuse: Reused the collaboration and shared-plugin production records only for their recorded baseline laws and proof limits. Re-read current Plate configure/extend types and implementation, nominal metadata, native Yjs factory and namespace registry, the Plate API mirror and four overloads, copied remote-cursor factory, real demo caller and capability/lifetime contracts. This bounded reassessment does not repeat or claim the whole plate-api census audit. No proposed API, new runtime, compiler prototype or benchmark was executed.
summary: Pursue declared construction inputs through configure, with extend retaining authoring/composition. The strongest cut is the public Plate/copied Yjs forwarding factories and handwritten native capability mirror. Current configure returning ConfiguredPlugin<C> is a revisable type contract, not proof that required host resources or conditional APIs require public factories. A generic declaration/adapter owner should preserve the factory input-to-result relation, specialize only declared capabilities, and create one binding lineage. This supersedes the blanket claim that non-widening configure forces these factories, while reaffirming shared descriptor identity and completed collaboration lifetime ownership.
alternatives: Keep createYjsPlugin and copied createCollaborationPlugin: valid runtime baseline, but the Plate factory mirrors native API groups and overloads and copied presentation adds generic forwarding. Those public wrappers are not established as required owners.

Use existing extend(yjs(options)): preserves the native closure and is the strongest smaller composition comparator; it still exposes binding assembly/imports and does not by itself preserve a reusable unbound copied preset with required generic inputs.

Repair generic native-factory adaptation alone: a required comparison that can remove the handwritten capability mirror; prefer it as the implementation of declared construction if it also preserves copied extension and input requirements without per-feature wrappers.
Supply doc/awareness through extend({ ... }): reject as the preferred consumer contract because it combines required input binding with author capability merging.

Support declared construction inputs through configure: preferred direction; derive the configured API from the declaration, keep required inputs non-nullable, preserve one private native binding, and retain extend for authors. Detailed syntax and generic feasibility are not yet accepted.
Add only a Yjs-specific configure method or alias createYjsPlugin behind an object: reject because it merely renames the factory and retains duplicated generic authoring.

Restore resources in initialState/public config, always expose unavailable APIs, split each capability into a companion plugin, or delete native/Plate ownership: reject because these add duplicate state/coordination or lose current inference, synchronization or presentation jobs.
proofLimits: Source-backed value verdict only. Existing production proof supports the unchanged baseline, not the proposed construction mechanism. No proposed call site was compiled, no product code changed, and no new runtime/performance/browser proof was run. Task design plan must prove the input/result type relation through raw/Plate/copied composition, required-input installation and typed author callbacks before binding, absent capabilities and validators, contextual/terminal override semantics, exact configured ancestry, independent bindings, rollback/cleanup and packed declarations. Any changed construction/runtime/type machinery remains provisional until its matched comparison passes. Adoption must repair current blanket non-widening and factory-only teaching through the doctrine owner.
